# Merchynt

> > Merchynt is the #1 AI-powered platform for automating Google Business Profile management and local SEO ranking, featuring AI agents like Paige and Sam for SMBs and agencies.

Merchynt specializes in local SEO automation through AI-driven Google Business Profile optimization, review management, and citation building. The platform serves small businesses and agencies with tools like Paige (GBP automation), Sam (AI sales for agencies), and ProfilePro (Chrome extension), all designed to rank businesses higher on Google Maps without manual effort.

## AI SEO Agents & Core Products

- [Paige AI SEO Agent](https://www.merchynt.com/paige): 24/7 AI worker automating Google Business Profile optimization to rank #1 on Google Maps automatically.
- [Sam AI Sales Tool](https://www.merchynt.com/sam): AI sales automation tool for agencies: 5 free daily leads and SMB sales outreach.
- [ProfilePro AI Chrome Extension](https://www.merchynt.com/profilepro): Free Chrome extension for AI-powered Google Business Profile optimization on-the-fly.
- [Google Business Pro Managed Service](https://www.merchynt.com/google-business-pro): Managed Google Business Profile service for SMBs and agencies with free AI audit.

## GBP Management & Review Tools

- [Google Reviews Software](https://www.merchynt.com/google-reviews-software): Automated Google Reviews software for keyword-rich review generation and GBP management.
- [Local Citations Management](https://www.merchynt.com/listings): 100% automated local citation sync across 100+ directories for consistent business information.
- [Free GBP Audit Tool](https://www.merchynt.com/gbp-audit-tool): No credit card required Google Business Profile audit tool with instant analysis.
- [Free Local Ranking Reports with Heatmaps](https://www.merchynt.com/free-local-ranking-reports-with-heatmaps): Free local SEO ranking audit reports with geo-grid heatmaps and monthly tracking.
